overall.headline: Nothing needs action today; coast still rough until 4 PM, then a rainy Sunday.
overall.bluf: NWS keeps a Coastal Flood Advisory for Pacifica until 4 PM today, with high tide near 1:30 PM, so keep clear of the shore and pier. Waves have eased and the Beach Hazards Statement ended at 6 AM; no FEMA alerts cover Pacifica. Rain and 30 mph gusts arrive Sunday. Abroad, the Kuwait drone killings, Gaza strikes and Ebola in Congo continue, and Spain votes Sunday.

local.note: Flood advisory to 4 PM; waves easing; rain Sunday.

regional.note: No state alerts; storm outages in the East.

world.note: Gulf drone attack, Gaza, Yemen, Ebola.

changes: Eased: waves are smaller (about 8 ft forecast) and the Beach Hazards Statement ended 6 AM; the Coastal Flood Advisory still runs to 4 PM (NWS).
Firmer: Sunday brings rain, a quarter to half inch, and gusts to 31 mph in Pacifica (NWS).
Update: Kuwait drone attack has no new reporting since Thursday evening; Iran offers a joint investigation (Al Jazeera).
New: MSF says two staff were killed in an Israeli strike near a Gaza clinic; Israel says it targeted Hamas (BBC).
New: a blast beside a school in eastern Afghanistan killed at least 7 to 10 students, with 90 or more hurt; officials blame a nearby explosives depot (NPR, BBC).
New: Israel's unity-government talks stalled; deadline December 6 (Al Jazeera). Spain votes Sunday.
Dropped as stale: DreamHost incident (resolved Thursday), tariff proposal, Zelensky interview, Kim Jong Un nuclear vow.

coming_up.when: Sat high tide about 1:30 PM; advisory to 4 PM
coming_up.title: King tide: Coastal Flood Advisory until 4 PM
coming_up.detail: Low spots near Beach Blvd may flood; stay off the pier and rocks.

coming_up.title: Rain and gusty south wind
coming_up.detail: A quarter to half inch of rain, gusts to 31 mph; more light rain Monday.

coming_up.title: Spain general election
coming_up.detail: Polls suggest the conservative PP wins most seats but needs far-right Vox for a majority.

coming_up.title: Caltrans one-way traffic on Hwy 1 near Montara, Pescadero and Half Moon Bay
coming_up.detail: Drainage, slide repair and paving; expect delays south of Pacifica.

coming_up.title: Deadline for Israeli coalition talks
coming_up.detail: Eisenkot's deadline to form a government; extendable by 14 days.

home_front.summary: Coastal flood advisory to 4 PM; no FEMA alerts.

items.title: Coastal Flood Advisory until 4 PM; king tide near 1:30 PM
items.detail: NWS keeps the advisory for the San Francisco Peninsula coast until 4 PM. The Beach Hazards Statement ended at 6 AM and forecast surf is smaller, but the pier is closed and shoreline rocks stay dangerous. No FEMA emergency alerts cover Pacifica.
items.action: Stay off the pier, jetties, rocks and bluff edges today; move cars from low shoreline spots before 1:30 PM. If water covers a road, don't drive through it.
items.where: Pacifica Pier, Beach Blvd, Rockaway, Sharp Park

home_front.summary: No Pacifica outage or hosting incident found.
Beach Blvd may flood at midday high tide.

items.title: Beach Blvd and low coastal roads may flood near 1:30 PM
items.detail: NWS warns some roads may close at high tide. I found no Caltrans closure for Hwy 1 or Beach Blvd this morning; Hwy 1 work near Montara starts Monday.
items.action: If water reaches the road, use Sharp Park Rd or Hwy 35 and check QuickMap.

home_front.summary: Air quality moderate (AQI 65); no local advisories.

default.task: Charge phones and power banks and check flashlight batteries.
default.why: Rain and gusts arrive Sunday, and PG&E outages are more likely in wind.

3d.task: Check you have three days of drinking water, about 1 gallon per person per day.

ladder.summary: Pier closed after last week's collapse.

items.title: Pacifica Pier stays closed after part of it collapsed Wednesday
items.detail: No new reports since Nov 27. KQED reported the end of the pier fell into the sea on Nov 25; the pier has been closed under a local emergency.

ladder.summary: Coast flooding eases; no state alerts.

items.title: King-tide advisories continue around the Bay through today
items.detail: NWS has no severe alerts for California this morning besides the coastal advisories. Weaker rain is forecast Sunday.

ladder.summary: Storm outages in the East; markets calm.

items.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after Thanksgiving storms
items.detail: BBC reported Friday that Pennsylvania and neighbouring states were worst hit. No newer count found; the S&P 500 rose 1.6% and the VIX fell to 23.8, below the stress level.

ladder.summary: Spain votes Sunday; Israel coalition talks stall.

items.title: Spain votes Sunday; far right may enter government
items.detail: Polls suggest the PP wins most seats but needs Vox. Results are expected Sunday night.

items.title: Israel has no government; unity talks stall
items.detail: The Oct 27 election gave neither side a majority; talks ended Sunday without a deal. Eisenkot's deadline is Dec 6.

ladder.summary: Afghan school blast; Taiwan counts votes.

items.title: Blast beside a school in eastern Afghanistan kills students
items.detail: NPR reports 7 dead and more than 90 hurt; BBC reports 10 dead and over 100 hurt. Officials say it began at a nearby explosives depot; the toll is rising.

ladder.summary: Kuwait drone deaths, Gaza strike, Ebola.

items.title: Italy and Kuwait blame Iranian-made drones for two deaths; Iran denies
items.detail: Two Italian technicians died from shrapnel Thursday. Iran calls it a false flag and offers a joint inquiry; no newer reporting since Thursday evening. Qatar reportedly warns it threatens talks.
items.action: If Gulf travel is planned, check State Department advisories.

items.title: MSF says two staff killed in Israeli strike on Gaza clinic
items.detail: Israel says it targeted Hamas members; the WHO condemned the strike. The ceasefire has held only loosely.

items.title: Ebola in eastern Congo: about 12,000 cases
items.detail: NPR (Nov 26) said fighting is hampering response; Al Jazeera calls it Congo's deadliest outbreak. No US case reported in these sources.
